preconditions.description: Attacker needs sufficient PUPPY tokens to trigger swapAndLiquify through transfers
swapAndLiquifyEnabled must be true (set via activateContract by owner)
Attacker needs BNB for arbitrage transactions and gas

violation_target.exploit_hint: 1. Ensure swapAndLiquifyEnabled is true by calling activateContract() as owner or waiting for owner to enable it. 2. Transfer sufficient PUPPY tokens to the contract to accumulate balance above minTokenNumberToSell threshold. 3. Trigger swapAndLiquify() by making a transfer from/to non-pair addresses. 4. The function will add liquidity with wrong token/BNB proportions (otherPiece tokens with only deltaBalance/3 BNB), creating price imbalance in the PancakeSwap pair. 5. Execute arbitrage trades on PancakeSwap to profit from the price discrepancy caused by the imbalanced liquidity addition. 6. The attacker's BNB balance should increase from the arbitrage profits.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The swapAndLiquify function has a critical bug in liquidity proportion calculation. When adding liquidity, it swaps tokenAmountToBeSwapped (75% of minTokenNumberToSell) for BNB, but only uses deltaBalance.div(3) (33% of received BNB) with otherPiece (75% of tokens) for liquidity. This creates a severely imbalanced token/BNB ratio in the PancakeSwap pair, causing significant price discrepancy that can be arbitraged for profit.
attempts.attack_strategy: 1. Impersonate owner to activate contract (enable swapAndLiquify). 2. Transfer sufficient PUPPY tokens to contract to exceed minTokenNumberToSell threshold. 3. Trigger swapAndLiquify via transfer from non-pair address. 4. The buggy liquidity addition creates price imbalance. 5. Execute arbitrage on PancakeSwap to profit from the discrepancy. 6. Verify attacker's BNB balance increased.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Set up interfaces for PuppySwapToken and PancakeRouter. 2. In setUp: impersonate owner, call activateContract(), inject PUPPY tokens to attacker. 3. In testExploit: record initial BNB balance, transfer tokens to contract to trigger swapAndLiquify, check pair reserves, execute arbitrage swap, verify BNB profit.
